company.shortDescription: kevin. is the payments reset no one saw coming.
company.description: Kevin. is a fintech company that provides an advanced account-to-account payment infrastructure to replace card transactions. It aims to evolve traditional cards, pay by link, POS, direct debit, and online payments. Offering fully customizable solutions which scale to the size of any business, kevin. helps improve customer experience and thereby conversion, while also saving money on the cost of payment acquiring services for the merchants.

productsAndServices.description: A white-label, brand-agnostic payment acceptance network enabling account-to-account payments online and in-store without changing consumer or cashier behavior.
productsAndServices.name: kevin. Payments Acceptance Network

productsAndServices.description: A feature allowing customers to link their bank accounts to merchant apps or websites for one-click payments without needing to enter card details repeatedly.
productsAndServices.name: Account Linking Feature

productsAndServices.description: A payment method that lets customers complete purchases with a single click by using previously linked bank accounts, streamlining checkout.
productsAndServices.name: One-Click Payments

productsAndServices.description: A security process replacing sensitive payment data with unique tokens to protect customer information during transactions.
productsAndServices.name: Payment Tokenization

productsAndServices.description: Developer tools including APIs and mobile SDKs for integrating kevin.'s payment infrastructure into websites, apps, and POS systems.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $65,068,273, or 81.93% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 13 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,468,355 to $448,604,294, a 60.07x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
